title: Connect Link Pannu Win Pannu
description: With clever clues and smart connections, the 'Onna Irukka Kaththukanum' team raises the stakes. The Chase round turns thrilling as everyone awaits which team wins the round.

title: Neeya Naana
description: Gopinath hosts a debate on women's jealousy, family dynamics, and freedom. Contestants share experiences, and he concludes that managed jealousy nurtures life.

title: Super Singer Junior
